description:
List installed fonts available to Photoshop.

Use when: choosing a font for photoshop_create_text_layer or photoshop_set_text_font.
TextItem.font requires the PostScript name — use postScriptName from results, or pass display name to set/create tools (they resolve automatically).

Returns: fonts array ({ name, postScriptName, family, style }), total count, truncated flag.
First call may be slow (app.fonts.length can exceed 1000). Side effects: none.

document_id.description: Optional Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. When set, the tool activates that document before running so a UI tab switch cannot retarget the edit.

query.description: Optional substring filter (matches name, postScriptName, or family)

name: photoshop_list_fonts
